source_window.dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) - Listed Buildings polygons, ArcGIS Hub static download

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for NHLE ListEntry 1169607 (North Warehouse, Canal Basin, Exeter). Historic England publishes the NHLE Listed Buildings polygon dataset through its Open Data Hub, and the official NHLE record explicitly identifies North Warehouse and its Exeter Maritime Museum use; however the distinct ArcGIS Hub static GeoJSON record-filter download URL was inaccessible through the available retrieval channel before any feature payload or polygon coordinates could be read. No geometry was inferred or fabricated, so no individual building record was accepted.
